title: SwissGear Sion Softside Expandable Roller Luggage - Unboxing & Review
transcript: [Video Description/Summary]: SwissGear Sion Softside Expandable Roller Luggage B014TMV5YE This rolling suitcase was spacious, well-built and easy to maneuver for its usage on a train and by its seats. The size would likely require this to be checked for airplanes. The shipment itself was incident-free and the case was well-packaged in its shipment.
